name: Tugay forests of the Tigrovaya Balka Nature Reserve
description: In southwestern Tajikistan, where the Vakhsh and Panj rivers meet to form the Amu Darya, lies a green belt of tugay: dense riverside forest growing on floodplain terraces. It is the largest and most intact forest of its kind in Central Asia, and the only place where Asiatic poplar woodland survives in its original state on this scale. Sandy desert and low mountains border the reserve.
